facts.claim: A Coorg named Channa Basava and his wife fled to the Residency for protection.
facts.quote: On the 17tli September 1832, I. A, Casamajor, Eesident in Mysore, reported to the Chief Secretary to the Government of Fort St. George, that a Coorg of the name of Channa Basava and his wife, D^vammdji, sister to the Rdjah of Coorg, had taken refuge at the Residency.

facts.claim: The couple were threatened with death by the Rdjah during a festival.
facts.quote: Of late the Edjah had made incestuous proposals to her through an old woman- servant, and had threatened to kill her husband, if she refused compliance, on the following Shivardtri festival.

facts.claim: They escaped by drugging the guard and traveling to Mysore, but were stopped by the Coorg frontier guard.
facts.quote: During the night they reached Beppundd, passed Amadndd in the morning and were drawing near the Mysore frontier, when they were stopped by the Coorg frontier guard. Being fired at, their party returned fire.
